method: OpenStreetMap building footprint way 24265381 (building=university, name '887'), used verbatim. Building number 887 matches the identification already recorded in site:cern-neutrino-platform-ehn1's own note ('also known as Building 887'). A WebSearch synthesis reported '55 m wide, 330 m long' for this building but no fetched primary page yielded a verbatim quote for that figure in this session (the two CERN pages found for it, be-dep-ea.web.cern.ch/experimental-areas/north-area/ehn1 and home.cern's LS2 North Area report, both 404'd on fetch), so no length checks[] row is asserted; the polygon's own measured max span is ~296 m, in the same range as that unconfirmed figure -- see the worklog.
name: EHN1 / Building 887 (CERN Neutrino Platform hall)

summary.plain: The North Area test-beam hall (EHN1, Building 887) on CERN's Prévessin site, home to the CERN Neutrino Platform, ProtoDUNE-SP/DP and NA64.
